summary: This clinical trial studies the effects of adding a PCSK 9 inhibitor to high-intensity statin therapy in patients with acute coronary syndrome after a percutaneous coronary intervention. Acute coronary syndrome means sudden heart-related chest pain or heart attack, and a percutaneous coronary intervention is a procedure to open blocked heart arteries. The study aims to see how this drug combination prevents future cardiovascular events. Sponsored by Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University, the trial includes 1212 participants.
